name: bambu-printer-events
description: Subscribe to completion and problem events from authorized Bambu printers in an operator-configured farm.

defaultPrompt: Notify me when my printer finishes a print or reports a problem.
interface.longDescription: Receive completion and problem notifications from printers your account is allowed to monitor. Requires an operator-configured authenticated MCP2 endpoint and a client with native MCP Events support. Legacy stdio clients do not gain durable notifications. Backend limitations apply; user-visible notification acceptance is not complete on this development branch.
